==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I willed my body to numb into sleep paralysis as I went to sleep. This allowed for almost instant lucidity. I focused on the feeling of pure bliss and happiness. Floating in space with a smile. An unknown entity approached me and told me of Aegis the Island of Heroes. Maybe next time I will try to visit Aegis.
